headline: 58 Google ads, a Verified advertiser badge - and a 3-day delivery promise on a page where Swiggy is faster.
ad_intro: Anand Sweets is one of the strongest paid footprints we found in Bengaluru food: 58 live Google Ads creatives under ANAND SWEETS AND SAVOURIES LLP - and Google shows the advertiser as Verified, which matters for a category where trust decides the order. The site carries 15+ Bengaluru stores, corporate gifting, wedding gifting and a Chak Now brand. The leak is the delivery promise: the site's own banner says Bangalore deliveries may take up to 3 days and points same-day buyers to Swiggy, Zomato or Ownly - so your paid traffic is being trained to leave and buy on someone else's app.
ad_intelligence: 58 live creatives; advertiser ANAND SWEETS AND SAVOURIES LLP shown as Google Verified - a real trust asset in the sweets category.
Site banner: 'Deliveries in Bangalore may take up to 3 Days' and routes same-day orders to Swiggy, Zomato or Ownly.

Own D2C (Shopify), the 15+ stores (Budigere, Electronic City, Commercial Street, Whitefield, Sarjapur, Frazer Town, Jayanagar, Koramangala, Kammanahalli, Hennur and more), quick-commerce, plus Chak Now (chaknow.com).
Corporate, personal and wedding gifting pages exist; corporate page carries care@anandsweets.net and Mon-Sat 10:00-17:30 timing; scale claim up to 2,000 boxes per order.
Founded 1988; one of South India's largest mithai brands with international shipping; third-party estimates around USD 30M revenue and 500-1,000 employees.
findings: You are advertising to send buyers to Swiggy: the top-of-site banner tells every paid visitor that Bangalore delivery takes up to 3 days and that same-day means Swiggy / Zomato / Ownly. In sweets, a large share of urgent same-day demand is gift-driven (Diwali, house-warming, corporate) - the highest-margin occasions. Every one of those is being handed to an aggregator that owns the customer data and takes the margin.

Gifting is under-served by paid: corporate and wedding gifting are the highest-order-value lines, yet the corporate page is reached by browsing. There should be a dedicated gifting campaign (search + Meta + LinkedIn for corporate HR/admin buyers) landing on the corporate page with the form and care@anandsweets.net immediately visible.

Festival/occasion calendar: with a Verified Google badge and 58 creatives, the account can own the Bengaluru festival mithai demand window - but the creatives need an occasion calendar (Diwali, Ugadi, Sankranti, weddings) with pre-built audiences and geo radii per store.
Retargeting depth is the weakest score: no visible retargeting structure for cart-abandoners or gifting-page visitors - both are high-value segments in this category.
competitors: Own same-day delivery expectation and take the customer data.
Publish a store pick-up + express option; convert urgency on your own domain.
Dense retail footprint, walk-in gifting flow.
Win online gifting with corporate pages, GST invoice, and pan-India shipping proof.
Lead with 'custom boxes up to 2,000 units' + India-wide shipping on the ad itself.
wins: WIN 1 - Stop sending paid traffic to Swiggy

Add a store-pickup / express option on the product page and reframe the banner: same-day = pick up today, or order online for delivery. Only route out to aggregators when the SKU genuinely cannot ship.

Run a dedicated campaign to HR / admin / founders: Google search for 'corporate diwali gifts bangalore', Meta lookalikes, and a retargeting sequence - all landing on the corporate page with GST invoice, custom branding and the care@anandsweets.net enquiry flow above the fold.

Build a 12-month festival/weekly occasion calendar with pre-loaded creatives, geo-radius audiences around all 15+ Bengaluru stores, and cart-abandonment retargeting. One store radius = one local ad set.
